# Sleep experiment

Two weeks with no caffeine after 1 pm and the phone charging outside the
bedroom.

## Findings

- Falling asleep took about 12 minutes instead of 35.
- Waking up at 3 am happened twice instead of most nights.
- An afternoon espresso cost roughly 40 minutes of deep sleep on the tracker.

## Keep doing

Caffeine cutoff at 1 pm, a dark and cool room, and the same wake-up time on
weekends.
